cycle.note: cycle = sum of the cut screen times minus the overlap of each transition (the push of the incoming clip starts at T0 and the leaving clip stays until T0 + duration)

transitionDefaults.rule: push 0.4 s between products and 0.3 s inside the same product; never a crossfade between cuts with different captions

steps.step: O Relloo atende e reconhece a pessoa
